note.text:
The net of a solid is the flat shape you get when you unfold it. Folding the net back gives the solid.
The net of a right prism has:
• the two bases (identical polygons), and
• the lateral faces, which together form one long rectangle: its length is the perimeter of the base and its width is the height of the prism.
A cube has 11 different nets; a common one is a cross of 6 squares.
The area of the net equals the total surface area of the prism.
To draw a net: draw the long rectangle divided into n parts (one for each side of the base), then attach one base above and one below.

worked_example.problem: Describe the net of a triangular prism.
steps: Unfold the {n} lateral faces: they make one long rectangle divided into {n} rectangles.
Attach the two triangular bases, one above and one below the rectangle.
worked_example.answer: Three rectangles in a row with a triangle above and a triangle below.

cards.idea: A net is the flat shape you get when you unfold a solid.
example: Fold it back to make the solid.

cards.idea: The net of a prism: {2} bases and a long rectangle of lateral faces.
example: The rectangle's length is the base perimeter.

check.prompt: The net of a {baseName(n, 'prism')} prism has a long rectangle made of its lateral faces. How many faces are there in the whole net?

cards.idea: The area of the net equals the total surface area.

pick.q: What is the net of a solid?
pick.r: the flat shape you get when you unfold it
e: That is not the maths meaning.
pick.y: Folding the net makes the solid.

pick.q: How many squares are in the net of a cube?
e: Eight is the number of vertices.
Twelve is the number of edges.

questions.prompt: The net of a {baseName(n, 'prism')} prism has a long rectangle made of its lateral faces. How many faces are there in the whole net?
The lateral rectangle of a prism's net is {p} cm long and {h} cm wide. Each base has an area of {b} cm². What is the area of the whole net?
solution: Add the two bases: {p * h} + {2} × {b} = {answer} cm².

questions.prompt: Which statement about nets is wrong?

right.text: A net folds to make the solid.
A cube's net has six squares.
The net's area is the surface area.
A prism's net has two identical bases.

wrong.text: The net of a triangular prism has three triangles.
wrong.explain: It has two triangles and three rectangles.

wrong.text: The lateral rectangle's length is the prism's height.
wrong.explain: Its length is the base perimeter; its width is the height.

wrong.text: The area of the net is the volume of the prism.
